scenario.title: Botanical garden tour
scenario.intro: You are visiting the university's botanical garden. A guide is giving instructions to visitors. Listen and repeat what the guide says.

sentences: Please stay on the marked paths.
The tropical greenhouse is open until four.
Photos are allowed, but please do not touch the plants.
The tall trees near the pond were planted more than a century ago.
If you would like to learn more, our volunteers can answer questions at the visitor center.
Before you leave, remember that the seeds and small plants sold in our gift shop are grown by students in the university's horticulture program.
